authorization_basis: user explicitly approved the exact N3-W Manager persistent path lease and Direct/Relay switching non-live development gate after the protected-main, PR #276, merged-predecessor, CI and protect-main bindings were revalidated

work_package.name: Manager persistent path lease, canonical cursor and Direct/Relay switching
work_package.goal: persist one active transport owner per node, require stable fail-closed switching, preserve a monotonic canonical boot/sequence cursor, and commit path ownership, cursor and replay/high-water changes in one SQLite transaction without production MQTT or live activation
allowed: same-database persistent N3-W path lease tables
explicit Direct owner and gateway-bound Relay owner
injected path policy for stability window, minimum distinct frames, lease TTL and old-path grace
persistent candidate evidence and restart recovery
persistent canonical boot-session and sequence cursor
shared ReplayRegistry BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction boundary
injected registration lifecycle ingress eligibility callback
host-only unit, restart, concurrency, corruption and rollback fault tests
dedicated GitHub CI and one Draft PR
forbidden: real key delivery or key rotation activation
real application keys in repository or CI evidence
T1, production Broker, Home Assistant, production Manager database, real credential, node or board access
ESP-NOW firmware or ESPHome product changes

transaction_order: BEGIN IMMEDIATE on the ReplayRegistry SQLite connection
candidate-only frames may persist candidate evidence but must not consume replay state
accepted active-owner or switch-completing frame atomically consumes replay and updates path lease plus canonical cursor
canonical in-memory commit and message construction
exit_gate: first valid path atomically establishes one active lease and canonical cursor
healthy Direct cannot be preempted by incidental Relay traffic
expired Direct can switch to a stable authorized Relay candidate
stable Direct can preempt an active Relay after the configured stability requirement
candidate duplicate or non-advancing evidence cannot fabricate stability
candidate evidence survives Manager restart without consuming replay tuples
same-boot unseen sequence rollback is rejected as stale_sequence
higher boot session advances and lower boot session fails closed across paths
old-path grace never canonicalizes or consumes a new tuple
retiring or retired lifecycle eligibility rejects before path/replay mutation
path-state write failure rolls replay/high-water back
replay write failure rolls path/cursor transition back
concurrent path contenders serialize to one durable owner
next_gate: Ready/merge requires a separate exact-head authorization. Production Manager MQTT relay subscription, service wiring, MQTT publication reliability/outbox work, real authorization/key provisioning, firmware, isolated dual-board testing and all live or physical execution remain separate gates.
